# QR Code Generator

`qrcode.js` is the unmodified JavaScript distribution from `qrcode-generator@1.4.4`
(Kazuhiko Arase, MIT). Downloaded from the npm release tarball; license from the upstream repository.

Upstream: https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator

Used only by the desktop editor to generate LAN sharing codes locally. No remote QR service.
